test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the grammatically correct sentence.**

options.text: The decision to change a hospital saved an life of the daughter of the doctor.
The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
The decision to change an hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
A decision to change a hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.

solution:
The correct answer is *'The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The grammatically correct sentence among the options is: *The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.*
 
• This sentence correctly uses the definite article "**the**" before "**hospital**," indicating a specific hospital that was changed.
 
• Additionally, it uses the correct word order and article ("**the**") before "**life**" and does not use the article "**an**" before "**hospital**."
 
• This structure creates a grammatically accurate and clear sentence conveying that a particular decision, which involves changing **a specific hospital**, had a significant impact on saving the doctor's daughter's life.

 

**Correct Answer:__** *The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.*
